_meta.description: SYNTHETIC HR ticket records. This file is the SEED state only. Tickets created by the agent are MOCK: they are written to an in-memory store at runtime and are never persisted back to this file, so the repository state is always reproducible and no agent action is irreversible (project req. s4).

tickets.subject: Request to work from Portugal in July
tickets.body: Requesting approval to work from Lisbon 6 - 24 July. Manager has confirmed coverage.
tickets.resolution: Approved. 19 calendar days, within the 30-day limit; Helios entity present in Portugal.

tickets.subject: Dependent verification documents
tickets.body: Adding two children to coverage; asking what documentation is required.
tickets.note: Verification due 2026-09-20 or dependent coverage is cancelled (POL-BEN-001 s5).

tickets.subject: Second monitor for modelling work
tickets.body: Requesting an additional 27-inch monitor beyond the standard Data/ML bundle.

tickets.subject: Short-term disability coverage question
tickets.body: Asking whether short-term disability applies to part-time employees.
tickets.resolution: Confirmed part-time employees are not covered by STD or LTD (POL-BEN-001 s3). State disability options discussed.

tickets.subject: Reimbursement for home office chair
tickets.body: Asking whether a new desk chair can be expensed.
tickets.resolution: Directed to the home-office stipend under POL-BEN-001 s8; not an expense claim (POL-EXP-001 s8).
